sentences.name: one_la_split_join_a
sentences.rationale: 1/1 cube long-axis: split the bar east–west and rejoin with a bridged shift; east half aligns the road front, north half steps back under the sunlight plane. Programme: main lobby east, support offices west.

sentences.name: one_la_split_join_b
sentences.rationale: 1/1 long-axis split+join variation: two volumes offset vertically so the taller east wing receives road address and the recessed west wing tucks under the north setback. Stepped section responds to daylight constraint.

sentences.name: one_la_branch_a
sentences.rationale: 1/1 long-axis branch: trunk runs north–south along the west side; east arm projects toward the road and provides covered entry. L-plan keeps north side lower.

sentences.name: one_la_embed_branch
sentences.rationale: 1/1 long-axis embed+branch case: courtyard volume embedded at centre then a branch cantilevered east over the entry court. Public office programme uses court as light well; branch contains meeting floors.

sentences.name: one_la_embed_overlap_a
sentences.rationale: 1/1 long-axis embed+overlap: inner void overlaps the outer skin on the north face to cut a recessed loggia; road-facing east elevation stays full-height. GFA targets upper FAR band.

sentences.name: one_la_embed_embed_a
sentences.rationale: 1/1 long-axis embed+embed: two nested voids subtract a cross-shaped atrium at mid-plan; perimeter offices ring the void on all five floors. East entry void is wider to signal public address.

sentences.name: one_la_bend_bend
sentences.rationale: 1/1 long-axis bend+bend: double curvature bends the bar first in plan (curving south flank toward entry plaza) then in section (upper floors tip north to reduce sunlight shadow). Continuous deformation, no discrete setback.

sentences.name: one_sa_rotate_array_stack_a
sentences.rationale: 1/1 short-axis rotate+array+stack: floor plates rotate slightly at each level and stack to produce a spiralling prismatic tower; compact footprint keeps coverage well below 60%.

sentences.name: one_sa_rotate_array_stack_b
sentences.rationale: 1/1 short-axis rotate+array+stack variant: wider inter-floor rotation angle creates more pronounced helix, shading the south face with successive overhangs.

sentences.name: one_sa_taper_array
sentences.rationale: 1/1 short-axis taper+array: tapered section narrows toward the top; arrayed along short axis to create a colonnaded base layer. Ground floor open to public circulation.

sentences.name: one_sa_carve_a
sentences.rationale: 1/1 short-axis carve: large arched carve on the east face creates a covered arrival space; volume above carve spans full width for continuous office floor plates.

sentences.name: one_sa_carve_offset_a
sentences.rationale: 1/1 short-axis carve+offset: lower body carved at north-east corner for sunlight; upper body offset southward to keep full floor plate on upper storeys. Two-part silhouette reads as stacked solids.

sentences.name: one_sa_inscribe_inscribe_a
sentences.rationale: 1/1 short-axis inscribe+inscribe: outer shell inscribes an inner volume rotated 15 degrees; gap between rings expressed as a continuous glazed slot on all four facades. Office floor plates within the inner prism.

sentences.name: one_sa_inscribe_inscribe_b
sentences.rationale: 1/1 short-axis inscribe+inscribe second variation: inner volume is an ellipse inscribed in the rectangular outer; gap widens on north and south to create planted buffer zones.

sentences.name: one_v_split_join_a
sentences.rationale: 1/1 vertical split+join: tower split horizontally at mid-height and rejoined with a horizontal bridge slab; lower podium faces east entry, upper tower rotated 10 degrees for views. Public hall on bridge level.

sentences.name: one_v_split_join_b
sentences.rationale: 1/1 vertical split+join variant: split at 3/5 height; lower volume thicker footprint, upper tapered. Sunlight setback absorbed by tapering upper body toward north.

sentences.name: one_v_carve_a
sentences.rationale: 1/1 vertical carve: cylindrical void carved vertically through the full tower height creates an interior atrium; upper glazed roof admits zenithal light. Carve centred near north, maintaining solid south face.

sentences.name: one_v_carve_offset_a
sentences.rationale: 1/1 vertical carve+offset: vertical carve on the north face then the body offset westward at mid-height to comply with the sunlight setback while preserving FAR near capacity ceiling.

sentences.name: one_v_carve_offset_b
sentences.rationale: 1/1 vertical carve+offset second variation: twin carves — one east entry notch, one north light channel — with the whole upper body offset toward the road to maximise floor plate efficiency.

sentences.name: one_v_inscribe_inscribe_a
sentences.rationale: 1/1 vertical inscribe+inscribe: outer rectilinear prism inscribes an inner cylinder; annular gap used as circulatory ring on each floor. Vertical orientation emphasises tower reading with minimum footprint.

sentences.name: one_v_inscribe_inscribe_b
sentences.rationale: 1/1 vertical inscribe+inscribe variant: inner volume scaled differently per floor, creating progressive inscribed depths — taller at base, narrower at top — for a sculptural profile.

sentences.name: one16_la_split_join_a
sentences.rationale: 1/16 slab long-axis split+join: thin bar split at east–west centre and rejoined offset north; creates a dogleg plan that addresses the road with its full narrow face. Slab occupies maximum east-west run.

sentences.name: one16_la_split_join_b
sentences.rationale: 1/16 slab long-axis split+join variation: the offset brings the north half forward, screening a service yard to the south. Both halves share the same five-storey height.

sentences.name: one16_la_carve_a
sentences.rationale: 1/16 slab long-axis carve: east face of the slab carved to recess the entry lobby; volume reads as a horizontal bar with a punched portal at ground level. Low BCR, high linear span.

sentences.name: one16_la_compress
sentences.rationale: 1/16 slab long-axis compress: thinnest possible floor plate compressed further along the depth axis to create a knife-edge building. Lower GFA justified by maximising north daylighting through minimum obstruction depth.

sentences.name: one16_la_carve_offset_a
sentences.rationale: 1/16 slab long-axis carve+offset: east end carved and the slab body offset upward at mid-point to form a raised west segment that captures morning light on its underside.

sentences.name: one16_la_embed_branch
sentences.rationale: 1/16 slab long-axis embed+branch: branch arm perpendicular to the main slab, creating an L or T condition; embedded void at junction acts as an open light court bridging programme zones.

sentences.name: one16_la_intersect_intersect_a
sentences.rationale: 1/16 slab long-axis intersect+intersect: two slabs cross at angles; intersection volume is the usable office core while the projecting arms house open-plan floors. Aggregation reads as a cruciform.

sentences.name: one16_sa_split_join_a
sentences.rationale: 1/16 slab short-axis split+join: slab split transversally and one half lowered to create a cascade; east high half at five storeys holds the road presence, west lower half is three storeys.

sentences.name: one16_sa_split_join_b
sentences.rationale: 1/16 slab short-axis split+join variation: the two halves are the same height but laterally displaced to create a staggered plan; covered walk links them at ground level.

sentences.name: one16_sa_compress_a
sentences.rationale: 1/16 slab short-axis compress: slab compressed along the short axis to near-minimum depth; result is a very flat bar whose east face becomes an almost-curtain-wall public facade.

sentences.name: one16_sa_compress_b
sentences.rationale: 1/16 slab short-axis compress variant: compressed bar lifted off ground on piloti; ground floor is semi-public open space. Five storeys of office above the piloti band.

sentences.name: one16_sa_embed_branch
sentences.rationale: 1/16 slab short-axis embed+branch: branch projects perpendicular to the slab's short face (eastward toward road); creates a T-plan with branch as lobby tower and slab as office wing.

sentences.name: one16_sa_embed_overlap_a
sentences.rationale: 1/16 slab short-axis embed+overlap: inner office slab overlaps a secondary volume on the south end, forming a thickened anchor. East face of the main slab remains the slim public face.

sentences.name: one16_sa_intersect_intersect_a
sentences.rationale: 1/16 slab short-axis intersect+intersect: two thin slabs intersect at 90 degrees to yield a plus-plan; intersection is structural core and vertical circulation. Each arm addresses a different site orientation.

sentences.name: one16_v_split_join_a
sentences.rationale: 1/16 slab vertical orientation split+join: the vertically oriented slab is split horizontally and rejoined with a gap; gap floor acts as an accessible sky garden between office zones.

sentences.name: one16_v_split_join_b
sentences.rationale: 1/16 slab vertical split+join variant: split at 40% height; lower volume is wider footprint for public programme, upper volume thin slab continues to full height.

sentences.name: one16_v_compress_a
sentences.rationale: 1/16 slab vertical compress: vertically oriented slab compressed radially to approach an elliptic cross section; thin oval prism reduces wind load and maximises perimeter glazing for all offices.

sentences.name: one16_v_compress_b
sentences.rationale: 1/16 slab vertical compress variant: compressed to a wider oval and then tilted slightly off vertical — a leaning slab tower that shifts its mass northward at the top to shed sunlight from the south plaza.

sentences.name: one16_v_embed_branch_a
sentences.rationale: 1/16 slab vertical embed+branch: upright slab with a branch arm at mid-height spanning east over the entry court; branch is a single-storey canopy volume that shades the lobby.

sentences.name: one16_v_embed_branch_b
sentences.rationale: 1/16 slab vertical embed+branch case 2: deeper branch at upper floors creates an asymmetric silhouette; embedded void below branch provides a two-storey atrium at public floor.

sentences.name: one16_v_intersect_intersect_a
sentences.rationale: 1/16 slab vertical intersect+intersect: vertical slab intersected by a second rotated volume producing a compound silhouette; the intersection core is reinforced concrete and the projecting wings are steel frame.

sentences.name: half_la_rotate_stack
sentences.rationale: 1/2 half-cube long-axis rotate+array+stack: floor plates rotated incrementally and stacked; east face presents a faceted vertical expression. Public office programme fills continuously stacked floor plates.

sentences.name: half_la_taper_array
sentences.rationale: 1/2 long-axis taper+array: tapered body widening from east (road) to west; arrayed as a repetitive bay system. Wider west end provides deeper floor plates for back-office functions.

sentences.name: half_la_compress_a
sentences.rationale: 1/2 long-axis compress: half-cube compressed into a squat bar; broad east face presents the public frontage. Compact depth reduces corridor travel distances for an efficient office layout.

sentences.name: half_la_embed_a
sentences.rationale: 1/2 long-axis embed: secondary volume embedded in the south-west corner; creates a covered loggia at ground level and a recessed conference floor at level 3. Embedding subtracted from main mass without disconnecting.

sentences.name: half_la_embed_overlap_a
sentences.rationale: 1/2 long-axis embed+overlap: embedded void overlaps the main body on the north elevation; overlap creates a thick north wall with interstitial service zone, keeping the south and east faces fully glazed.

sentences.name: half_la_embed_embed_a
sentences.rationale: 1/2 long-axis embed+embed: two sequential voids embedded concentrically; inner void is a sky garden at the building centre, outer void is a buffer ring of service cores. Programme wrapped around both voids.

sentences.name: half_la_intersect_intersect
sentences.rationale: 1/2 long-axis intersect+intersect: two volumes at oblique plan angles intersect; primary volume aligned east–west for road access, secondary rotated 30 degrees to follow solar angle. Intersection core is shared circulation.

sentences.name: half_sa_rotate_stack
sentences.rationale: 1/2 half-cube short-axis rotate+array+stack: each floor plate rotated and stacked along the short axis; produces a spiralling compact block. North facade benefits from reduced solar exposure due to plate rotation.

sentences.name: half_sa_taper_array
sentences.rationale: 1/2 short-axis taper+array: body tapers along the short axis toward the north to yield a wedge-profile building; lower north edge respects the sunlight setback without a discrete step.

sentences.name: half_sa_embed_a
sentences.rationale: 1/2 short-axis embed: void embedded in the east face of the half-cube to create a recessed arcade at ground and first floors; upper three floors are continuous office plates projecting over the arcade.

sentences.name: half_sa_carve_offset_a
sentences.rationale: 1/2 short-axis carve+offset: north-east corner carved and the upper mass offset south-west; double move reduces bulk at the sunlight setback zone while keeping floors large on the south side.

sentences.name: half_sa_carve_offset_b
sentences.rationale: 1/2 short-axis carve+offset variant: shallower carve, larger offset; the overhanging south block creates a semi-sheltered courtyard below.

sentences.name: half_sa_embed_embed_a
sentences.rationale: 1/2 short-axis embed+embed: two voids at different scales embedded in the block; large west void is a full-height atrium, small east void is the entry alcove. Together they give a clear hierarchy between public and private realms.

sentences.name: half_sa_embed_embed_b
sentences.rationale: 1/2 short-axis embed+embed variant: voids embedded on opposing faces (east and west) producing a figure-eight hollow section; structural walls between voids carry load while each void is a distinct amenity space.

sentences.name: half_v_split_join_a
sentences.rationale: 1/2 half-cube vertical split+join: tower volume split vertically into two wings bridged at floors 3 and 5; east wing faces road, west wing faces interior court. Bridge floors are shared meeting rooms.

sentences.name: half_v_split_join_b
sentences.rationale: 1/2 vertical split+join variation: wings diverge in plan rather than just separating vertically; divergence opens a triangular courtyard facing east toward the road.

sentences.name: half_v_embed_a
sentences.rationale: 1/2 vertical embed: cylindrical void embedded vertically at the building's heart; five-storey atrium lit from above. Floor plates in a doughnut ring around the void, 5 floors.

sentences.name: half_v_embed_b
sentences.rationale: 1/2 vertical embed variant: rectangular void embedded off-centre toward the north face; asymmetric plan creates a deeper south wing and a shallow north service strip.

sentences.name: half_v_carve_offset_a
sentences.rationale: 1/2 vertical carve+offset: carve on the south face then offset upper floors northward; north_side=south because programme benefits from open south court at the access zone; sunlight setback still honoured by offset geometry.

sentences.name: half_v_embed_embed_a
sentences.rationale: 1/2 vertical embed+embed: stacked pair of voids — lower is a double-height lobby void, upper is a roof garden void. Each embedded volume is distinct in size; together they articulate public from office storeys.

sentences.name: half_v_embed_embed_b
sentences.rationale: 1/2 vertical embed+embed variant: voids on east and west faces simultaneously; east void is the lobby cut, west void is an enclosed garden. Section reads as a bow-tie between two outdoor moments.

sentences.name: qtr_la_split_join_a
sentences.rationale: 1/4 quarter-cube long-axis split+join: bar split at mid-length and offset vertically to create a stepped section; lower east half at road level, upper west half stepped up as a roof terrace element.

sentences.name: qtr_la_split_join_b
sentences.rationale: 1/4 long-axis split+join variation: the two halves are sheared past each other and bridged; produces a Z-plan occupying the east–west parcel width efficiently.

sentences.name: qtr_la_embed_a
sentences.rationale: 1/4 long-axis embed: rounded void embedded in the north face of the bar to create a recessed garden at the sunlight setback; upper floors bridge over the void without interrupting the floor plate.

sentences.name: qtr_la_expand_a
sentences.rationale: 1/4 long-axis expand: bar expanded outward on the east face to create a thickened public frontage; expansion is bell-shaped, widest at ground level and tapering to match the standard section above floor 2.

sentences.name: qtr_la_embed_branch_a
sentences.rationale: 1/4 long-axis embed+branch: branch cantilevered from mid-bar toward the road creates an east wing canopy; void embedded at junction provides daylit atrium between bar and branch.

sentences.name: qtr_la_embed_overlap_a
sentences.rationale: 1/4 long-axis embed+overlap: second volume overlaps the bar on the south, creating a shared floor zone; overlap is expressed as a glazed connector between the two masses in section.

sentences.name: qtr_la_embed_embed_a
sentences.rationale: 1/4 long-axis embed+embed: dual embedded voids at the east and west ends of the bar; east void is the public lobby, west void is a utility recess. Together they give the bar a clear public–service hierarchy.

sentences.name: qtr_sa_rotate_stack_a
sentences.rationale: 1/4 quarter-cube short-axis rotate+array+stack: compact floor plates rotated 5 degrees per floor and stacked; produces a slight helix that reduces shadow on the north neighbour.

sentences.name: qtr_sa_split_join_a
sentences.rationale: 1/4 short-axis split+join: the quarter-cube split along its short axis and each half shifted east–west; plan becomes a pinwheel around a shared stair core.

sentences.name: qtr_sa_expand_a
sentences.rationale: 1/4 short-axis expand: body expanded northward to absorb unused setback area at lower floors while respecting the top-floor legal plan. Expansion is graded — maximum at ground, minimal at floor 5.

sentences.name: qtr_sa_expand_b
sentences.rationale: 1/4 short-axis expand variant: expansion on the east face only, creating a tapered bay that widens toward the road and signals the entry from the street.

sentences.name: qtr_sa_embed_branch_a
sentences.rationale: 1/4 short-axis embed+branch: branch arm extends south from the main body; embedded void at the junction serves as a two-storey public gallery linking the two volumes.

sentences.name: qtr_sa_embed_overlap_a
sentences.rationale: 1/4 short-axis embed+overlap: overlapping secondary volume on the west creates a thick west wall housing service cores; east and south faces remain slim and fully glazed for offices.

sentences.name: qtr_sa_embed_embed_a
sentences.rationale: 1/4 short-axis embed+embed: two voids embedded diagonally opposite in the block; creates a diagonal transparency through the building from the road to the rear garden.

sentences.name: qtr_v_split_join_a
sentences.rationale: 1/4 quarter-cube vertical split+join: compact tower split horizontally at floor 3; lower podium expands to maximum BCR, upper office tower is setback from north to comply with sunlight constraint.

sentences.name: qtr_v_split_join_b
sentences.rationale: 1/4 vertical split+join variation: lower and upper parts are bridged by a single-storey skybridge at level 4; bridge is a transparent link with shared amenity for both office zones.

sentences.name: qtr_v_expand_a
sentences.rationale: 1/4 vertical expand: compact tower expanded downward at base to form a wider podium; upper tower stays within the sunlight setback envelope. Podium provides covered public drop-off on the east.

sentences.name: qtr_v_expand_b
sentences.rationale: 1/4 vertical expand variant: expansion on the south face of the tower adds a series of cantilevered balcony pods; section reads as a cactus silhouette with progressive expansions.

sentences.name: qtr_v_embed_branch_a
sentences.rationale: 1/4 vertical embed+branch: branch arm at level 2 extends east over the footpath and provides a canopied arrival. Embedded void at the base of the tower forms the lobby atrium.

sentences.name: qtr_v_embed_overlap_a
sentences.rationale: 1/4 vertical embed+overlap: secondary volume overlaps the tower on the west at upper floors; overlap adds rentable area where the sunlight setback is less strict, boosting FAR toward target.

sentences.name: qtr_v_taper_taper
sentences.rationale: 1/4 vertical taper+taper: double-taper in section — wide at ground, narrowing at mid-height, then flaring again at the top to form a waisted tower silhouette. Narrow waist coincides with the sunlight setback level.

sentences.name: eighth_la_rotate_stack
sentences.rationale: 1/8 thin-bar long-axis rotate+array+stack: very slender bar plates rotated and stacked to create a dynamic ribbon tower; east end presents the shortest face to the road for minimum street obstruction.

sentences.name: eighth_la_taper_array
sentences.rationale: 1/8 long-axis taper+array: thin bar tapered along its length so the east (entry) end is narrowest; arrayed as a fin-wall arrangement across the site. Fins provide structural stability and shading.

sentences.name: eighth_la_expand
sentences.rationale: 1/8 long-axis expand: thin bar expanded at its centre creating a lozenge footprint; east and west ends remain pointed, mid-point is the widest floor plate for shared workstations.

sentences.name: eighth_la_carve_offset_a
sentences.rationale: 1/8 long-axis carve+offset: bar carved on its south face and offset northward; creates a sheltered south court as an outdoor amenity zone accessed from the lobby.

sentences.name: eighth_la_inscribe_inscribe_a
sentences.rationale: 1/8 long-axis inscribe+inscribe: thin bar with an inscribed secondary bar at 45 degrees; crossing bars form an X-plan building with four sheltered courts at the re-entrant corners.

sentences.name: eighth_la_extract_a
sentences.rationale: 1/8 long-axis extract: a portion of the bar is extracted (pulled outward) to form a separate fin element; extracted wing is an external stair and meeting pod attached at each floor level.

sentences.name: eighth_sa_taper_array
sentences.rationale: 1/8 thin-bar short-axis taper+array: bars tapered along the short axis and arrayed to create a saw-tooth section; each tooth channels light into the floor plate from north-facing sawtooth glazing.

sentences.name: eighth_sa_bend_a
sentences.rationale: 1/8 short-axis bend: thin bar bent in plan around the east entry corner; curved east face creates a convex road presence and a concave internal courtyard face. Continuous curved facade in five storeys.

sentences.name: eighth_sa_bend_b
sentences.rationale: 1/8 short-axis bend variant: bar bent more aggressively to near 90 degrees; plan reads as a curved L sheltering a south-facing garden from north winds.

sentences.name: eighth_sa_carve_offset_a
sentences.rationale: 1/8 short-axis carve+offset: bar carved at east entry and offset up at the same time; produces a split-level entry with the public floor half a storey above grade for accessible ramp approach.

sentences.name: eighth_sa_inscribe_inscribe_a
sentences.rationale: 1/8 short-axis inscribe+inscribe: short bar with a narrower bar inscribed inside at a skewed angle; the angular inscription cuts open the corners to create diagonal sightlines at each end of the building.

sentences.name: eighth_sa_split_join_a
sentences.rationale: 1/8 short-axis split+join: thin bar split along its short axis creating two narrow parallel bars connected at alternate floors; forms a hollow double-bar section with an open slot between.

sentences.name: eighth_v_split_join_a
sentences.rationale: 1/8 thin-bar vertical split+join: tall thin bar split vertically into two even thinner towers bridged at the top; twin-tower silhouette with a shared skybridge as meeting floor.

sentences.name: eighth_v_bend_a
sentences.rationale: 1/8 vertical bend: tower bent in section so the upper floors lean slightly east toward the road; base sits on the legal plan, top overhangs the entry plaza as a welcoming gesture.

sentences.name: eighth_v_bend_b
sentences.rationale: 1/8 vertical bend variant: tower bent northward in section; the lean shifts mass away from the south court and creates a covered north terrace at ground level.

sentences.name: eighth_v_branch_a
sentences.rationale: 1/8 vertical branch: thin tower with a branch at floor 3 extending east; branch provides a large meeting room cantilevered over the street-level plaza, creating a covered outdoor space below.

sentences.name: eighth_v_embed_branch_a
sentences.rationale: 1/8 vertical embed+branch: embedded void at the base of the thin tower forms a double-height lobby; branch at floor 4 projects south to create a sky garden overlooking the parcel.

sentences.name: eighth_v_inscribe_intersect
sentences.rationale: 1/8 vertical intersect+intersect: two thin bars intersecting at high level; ground floors are separate, upper floors merge at the crossing forming a shared floor plate with diagonal structural transfer.

sentences.name: lshape_la_rotate_stack
sentences.rationale: 3/8 L-volume long-axis rotate+array+stack: L-shaped plates rotated and stacked; rotation shifts the re-entrant corner outward at each floor, creating a progressively opening courtyard from ground to roof.

sentences.name: lshape_la_taper_array
sentences.rationale: 3/8 L-volume long-axis taper+array: the L-shape is tapered so the spine arm thins toward the south; arrayed in section to create a descending north wing that respects the sunlight setback incrementally.

sentences.name: lshape_la_branch_a
sentences.rationale: 3/8 L-volume long-axis branch: branch arm added to the L at the inner corner; creates a U-plan that frames a north-facing courtyard. East arm gives road presence, south arm adds office depth, branch links them.

sentences.name: lshape_la_embed_branch_a
sentences.rationale: 3/8 L-volume long-axis embed+branch: embed void at the inner re-entrant corner of the L to form a covered outdoor room; branch arm extends east from the long arm toward the road.

sentences.name: lshape_la_intersect_intersect_a
sentences.rationale: 3/8 L-volume long-axis intersect+intersect: two L-volumes rotated and intersected to form a complex interlocking section; intersection zone is the stairwell and service core shared by both wings.

sentences.name: lshape_la_carve_a
sentences.rationale: 3/8 L-volume long-axis carve: large carve on the inner corner of the L opens up the re-entrant to a full-height atrium; both arms of the L are connected at each floor by bridges spanning the carved void.

sentences.name: lshape_sa_rotate_stack
sentences.rationale: 3/8 L-volume short-axis rotate+array+stack: L-plates rotated around the short axis and stacked; short arm of the L rotates into a covered arcade below the long arm at upper floors.

sentences.name: lshape_sa_branch_a
sentences.rationale: 3/8 L-volume short-axis branch: branch from the short arm of the L spans east to the road; branch is a glazed connector housing a public stair that ties the street level to the main entry on the upper floor.

sentences.name: lshape_sa_embed_branch_a
sentences.rationale: 3/8 L-volume short-axis embed+branch: embedded void in the long arm creates a mid-building sky garden; branch from the short arm reaches the road. Together they form a campus-like open public plan.

sentences.name: lshape_sa_embed_branch_b
sentences.rationale: 3/8 L-volume short-axis embed+branch variation: branch at the top floor only, creating a roof-level bridge between the arms; roof bridge is a meeting zone with views over the parcel and access to both office wings.

sentences.name: lshape_sa_intersect_intersect_a
sentences.rationale: 3/8 L-volume short-axis intersect+intersect: L-volume intersected with a rectangular bar; intersection at the corner of the L forms a thickened structural joint while the bar extends as an east-facing public wing.

sentences.name: lshape_sa_carve_a
sentences.rationale: 3/8 L-volume short-axis carve: the inner concave face of the L is carved further to create a rounded court; the courtyard becomes a garden court lined with office glazing on three sides.

sentences.name: lshape_v_taper_array_a
sentences.rationale: 3/8 L-volume vertical taper+array: the upright L is tapered so each arm thins toward the top; arrayed vertically the taper gives the building a sculptural profile and reduces solar gain on upper floors.

sentences.name: lshape_v_taper_array_b
sentences.rationale: 3/8 L-volume vertical taper+array variant: arms taper at different rates — the long arm tapers quickly while the short arm stays constant; asymmetric profile reduces massing at the north-west corner near the sunlight boundary.

sentences.name: lshape_v_branch_a
sentences.rationale: 3/8 L-volume vertical branch: branch extends from the inner corner of the upright L horizontally at level 2; creates a covered ground-level plaza between the two L arms, with the branch as a roof.

sentences.name: lshape_v_embed_branch_a
sentences.rationale: 3/8 L-volume vertical embed+branch: void embedded at the base of the vertical L forms a public hall; branch at floor 3 projects south from the short arm to add area above the sunlit zone.

sentences.name: lshape_v_embed_overlap_a
sentences.rationale: 3/8 L-volume vertical embed+overlap: secondary volume overlaps at the base of the long arm, thickening the ground-floor public podium; upper floors retain the lean L-profile to stay within the sunlight envelope.

sentences.name: lshape_v_embed_embed_a
sentences.rationale: 3/8 L-volume vertical embed+embed: two voids embedded in the vertical L — one at the inner corner as a light well, one at the base of the short arm as a piloti-like open passage. Both keep the mass connected.
